For 18 months I ran the Big Gym of the Grant Woods branch (BGCEV).

I had an absolute blast planting seeds of confidence, generosity, and empathy while learning just as much from all my kids. To this date, it has been my most memorable and fulfilling work experience. And it paid the least. 😊
